# ledger commands

Every `ledger` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `ledger:probe`

Append a probe event to this node's ledger to check replication to its peers

```bash
bin/semitexa ledger:probe
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--note` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `ledger:replay`

Replay ledger events to the main database (recovery / projection rebuild)

```bash
bin/semitexa ledger:replay
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--since` | yes |
| `--domain` | yes |
| `--event-type` | yes |
| `--origin` | yes |
| `--dry-run` | no |

## `ledger:status`

Show replication state of this node's ledger

```bash
bin/semitexa ledger:status
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |
| `--probe` | yes |

## `ledger:verify`

Verify the SQLite ledger hash chain and HMAC signatures

```bash
bin/semitexa ledger:verify
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--origin` | yes |
